name: Shrine Flash Longlens
description: Chat Pile 'Shrine' (David Fitt, 2026-09-04, album 'Who Loves the Sun'): long-lens environmental scenes, hard cuts on impact, single over-exposed flash cut for the build. Noise-rock on post-rock/art-noise axis. Earth tones, slow drift, low FX overall so the flash-cut reads as the singular punctuation.
